title.narrative: Support to tri-partite cooperation on crises assessments (RPBA, PDNA, PRNA)

description.narrative: The overall objective to which this action contributes is to support third countries to build up their capacity to carry out Recovery and Peacebuilding Assessments (RPBA)/Post Disaster Needs Assessments (PDNA)/Pandemic Recovery Needs Assessments (PRNA), through provision of technical expertise. Various activities are foreseen, including deployment of experts in RPBA/PDNA/PRNA missions, and provision of training and capacity building activities to national authorities and regional/international organizations, tripartite training events, as well as information sessions for EU entities.
